title: MiniMax prices M3.1 Flash at $0.15 per million input tokens
friendlyTitle: MiniMax prices a faster agent model at 15 cents per million input tokens
summary: MiniMax has released M3.1 Flash through its API, M Plan, and MiniMax Code desktop app. The published price is $0.15 per million input tokens, $0.60 per million output tokens, and $0.015 for cached input. MiniMax says everyday output can exceed 200 tokens a second, that agent-task cost is about 70% lower than the previous model, and that online inference is nearly three times faster. It reports 73.7% on DeepSWE v1.1, a software-engineering test, and says weights will be released later.

whyItMatters: If an agent burns millions of tokens on coding or multi-step office work, the bill is now a published rate, not a demo. The benchmark numbers are the company's. The useful part is the price and the fact that the weights are not open yet, so today this is an API, not a file you can run offline.
